warp.observations: APK 20, receiver P3 (RF8Y30L038L), Reduced Motion 'כבויה', cold start (force-stop + launch) each run, friends fast room, P1 sent 'עיוות' as the first hit 15-25 s after the board (on1 ~60 s). Six runs were measured (one sound-ON attempt failed before the warp and was discarded). The old symptom (136-150 ms of identical frames, then a jump to near full strength) was NOT reproduced as such. In every run the fade-in is gradual. Sound ON: longest frozen stretch 100, 110 and 61 ms; 20/20/28 fps in the first 0.5 s. Sound OFF: 69, 67 and 67 ms; 30/30/34 fps. So sound ON is worse in all three runs, but it does not cause the stall alone. Common to both conditions (sound-independent first-hit cost): (1) the JS thread renders the hit for 165-200 ms in one burst before anything mounts; (2) the UI thread mounts it over 3-5 frames (preMountItems 14-30 ms each, createViewUnsafe(RNSVGPath) many times, createViewUnsafe(AndroidTextInput) 8-18 ms, over 8 ms only in the sound-ON runs); (3) the first draw of the new views (Record View#draw) takes 21-33 ms inside a 70-76 ms doFrame, with a RenderThread gap of 50-71 ms (OFF) and 57-112 ms (ON); (4) after that, each frame's Choreographer 'animation' phase takes 25-47 ms on the UI thread. This work has no trace slices: it is most likely Reanimated worklets or Skia drawing on the UI thread. It keeps the effect at about 30 fps. Extra with sound ON, every run: the play starts a fresh ExoPlayer audio path (new ExoPlayer:Audio and AudioTrack thread ids at the hit; ExoPlayer:Playback doSomeWork 82-124 ms incl. bypassRender 26-31 ms). In 2 of 3 runs a NativeAlloc concurrent mark-compact GC (160-186 ms) follows. None of it blocks the UI thread: there is no long binder call, no D state, and no AudioTrack/MediaPlayer creation on main. It competes for CPU instead: main is preempted in R state, and the two worst stalls coincide with ExoPlayer start (on1) and the GC (on2). Not seen: blocking GC on main, Skia/GL shader compile (at most 10 ms total on RT), a long binder transaction. Method limits: no trace_processor is available locally, and @perfetto/trace_processor is not on npm. So the six traces were captured with on-device atrace in text form, with the same categories (gfx input view wm am sched freq idle audio hal dalvik binder_driver, -a app), and parsed with Python. The release build has no Hermes/JS slices, and the app is not profileable, so simpleperf could not attribute the 'animation' phase. gfxinfo framestats keeps only the last 120 frames; it was dumped about 7 s after the hit, so it does not cover the hit (files kept anyway). The screenrecord is variable-rate at the 90 Hz display; frames were decoded in headless Edge and compared frame by frame.
warp.suspects: 1 (main, both conditions): the first warp builds its whole layer at hit time: a 165-200 ms JS render, a mount spread over several frames (incl. an AndroidTextInput and many RNSVGPath views), and a 21-33 ms first draw. Then 25-47 ms of UI-thread animation work per frame. Fix direction: mount the warp layer hidden ahead of time (at game start / standby) so the hit only animates props, and/or lighten the per-frame UI-thread work (Skia/Reanimated) of the warp. 2 (sound ON, secondary): each play rebuilds the ExoPlayer audio track (new AudioTrack threads, 82-124 ms of player work) and often triggers a NativeAlloc GC. That steals CPU during the fade-in: ~30% fewer frames in the first 0.5 s and the longest stalls (100-110 ms). Fix direction: start the cue a few frames after the first visible warp frame (useHitFeedback afterUiStart), or keep the hit cue on a player that does not rebuild its track (SoundPool-style low-latency path). Not supported by the traces: the volume setter, audio focus, a main-thread binder call, shader compile.

appBugs.title: עיוות ראשון אחרי הפעלה נקייה: האטה לכ־20–30 פריימים לשנייה ועצירות של 60–110 מ"ש (עם צליל)
appBugs.what: APK 20, טלפון 3 מקבל, הפעלה נקייה, חדר חברים מהיר, הפחתת תנועה כבויה. 3 ריצות עם צליל ו־3 בלי צליל, כל אחת עם atrace והקלטת מסך. הקפאה של 150 מ"ש עם פריימים זהים לא חזרה, והדהייה הדרגתית בכל הריצות. עם צליל: עצירה ארוכה של 100, 110 ו־61 מ"ש, ו־20–28 פריימים לשנייה ב־0.5 השנייה הראשונה. בלי צליל: 67–69 מ"ש, ו־30–34 פריימים לשנייה. בשני המצבים: ה־JS מרנדר את שכבת ההפרעה 165–200 מ"ש, ה־UI thread מרכיב אותה על פני כמה פריימים (כולל AndroidTextInput של 8–18 מ"ש), הציור הראשון לוקח 21–33 מ"ש, ואחר כך כל פריים לוקח 25–47 מ"ש של עבודת אנימציה ב־UI thread. עם צליל נוסף בכל ניגון נתיב שמע חדש של ExoPlayer (עבודה של 82–124 מ"ש ו־threads חדשים של AudioTrack), ובשתיים מתוך שלוש הריצות גם GC מקבילי של 160–186 מ"ש. הם לא חוסמים את ה־UI thread אלא מתחרים איתו על המעבד. קבצים: qa-shots/measure15-*
